capabilities: Bidirectionally sync Markdown notes as PostgreSQL rows, including frontmatter as JSONB
Upload and delete binary attachments in a private Supabase Storage bucket
Queue changes offline and sync automatically when a connection returns
Resolve conflicts between devices using hashes and timestamps
Export the synced database to a local .sql backup file
extras: README warns users to back up their vault before initial setup and testing; detailed setup, sync-strategy, and development guides live outside the README.
intentEvidence: This is an unofficial sync solution. Obsidian Sync is the officially supported service.
problem: Obsidian's official Sync is a paid closed service, so users who want vault sync through their own database and storage backend have no built-in option.

relations.evidence: This is an unofficial sync solution. Obsidian Sync is the officially supported service.
bidirectionally synchronizes vault notes to a Supabase PostgreSQL database

requires.name: Supabase Project URL and API Key

summary: Offline-first plugin that bidirectionally syncs vault notes to a Supabase PostgreSQL database and attachments to Supabase Storage.
